subject: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & timeline for Acme Cloud
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>; Dan Ortiz <dan.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & timeline for Acme Cloud

Hi Elena / Dan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement moving:

Call recap / what we heard
- Primary use: customer-facing summarization and search features in Acme Console (low-latency reqs).
- Security checklist: SOC 2 Type II + VPC/networking questions for private deployment.
- Commercial: prefer a committed monthly capacity; procurement team is evaluating PO vs card vs purchasing through AWS Marketplace.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) & milestones
1) Commercial proposal & quote (this week) — Redwood to send pricing deck + order form (attached). Target: 2026-03-04
2) Legal review — Acme legal reviews standard MSA; handshake to Redwood legal if redlines needed. Target: 2026-03-11
3) Security review — Acme security to review SOC 2 evidence and, if needed, schedule a short tech call. Target: 2026-03-12
4) Finance / PO issuance — Acme finance issues PO or confirms card payment / marketplace purchase. Target: 2026-03-18
5) Kickoff & staging access — Once PO/contract signed, we coordinate onboarding and dedicated capacity. Target: 2026-03-22

Open questions for Acme procurement/finance
- What is your preferred commercial path: PO (net-30) vs company card vs AWS Marketplace listing?
- If PO, do you have a procurement contact and any required legal clause checklist we should pre-check?

Attachments I shared:
- 20260302-redwood-pricing-deck.pdf (pricing & commitment tiers)
- MAP-AcmeCloud-20260302.docx (editable mutual action plan)

If helpful, I can loop in Aditya (contracts) and Ben (customer success lead) to accelerate the legal and onboarding questions.

Next steps
- Elena / Dan: let me know preferred payment path and any procurement contacts to include on the MAP.
- Redwood: we’ll send the formal quote and editable MAP by EOD today (attached).

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dan Ortiz <dan.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & timeline for Acme Cloud

Thanks Camila — helpful summary. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

1) Procurement path: we prefer PO (net-30) but need to understand if there are any account-level constraints to using AWS Marketplace (would prefer marketplace for consolidated billing if available). Is Redwood listed there?

2) Security: our security team will need SOC 2 artifacts and answers to a few specific questions around data residency and logs retention. Can you share the SOC 2 report and a short FAQ for security?

3) Legal: if there are material redlines required, who should our counsel send them to?

We’ll loop in our procurement lead (cc’d Dan) and finance if we commit to PO.

—Elena
Elena Park
Head of Product Operations | Acme Cloud
elena.park@acmecloud.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>; Dan Ortiz <dan.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & timeline for Acme Cloud

Hi Elena — great questions, answered inline below. Looping Aditya (legal) and Ben (CS) to help on the procurement and security threads.

> Is Redwood listed on AWS Marketplace?
Short answer: Yes — Redwood has a listing for our Hosted API and dedicated capacity options. Marketplace purchases are supported; note that committed pricing via Marketplace uses a contract/offer flow that can add ~3-5 business days for setup compared to PO. If your preference is marketplace, we can route the quote that way.

> SOC 2 artifacts and security FAQ
We’ve attached a SOC 2 Type II summary and a short security FAQ. If your team needs the full report under an NDA, we can route that securely. For your questions:
- Data residency: Hosted API stores data in-region by default; Dedicated and Private options allow customer-managed VPCs and storage retention controls.
- Logs/audit: We provide audit logs and retention controls; retention policy can be configured for enterprise plans.

> Legal redlines
Please send any redlines to legal@redwood.ai — Aditya will be the primary reviewer. If there are standard procurement clauses (PO reference number, invoice address, tax ID), please include them in the MAP and Aditya will pre-check.

Proposed updated timeline (minor adjustments)
- 2026-03-04: Redwood final quote + editable MAP (attached) — we’ll include both PO and Marketplace quote lines
- 2026-03-09: Acme legal / security review kickoff (we can schedule a 30-min sync)
- 2026-03-16: Contract + PO expected (target)
- 2026-03-23: Onboarding/kickoff (target)

Attachments included:
- 20260302-redwood-pricing-deck.pdf
- MAP-AcmeCloud-20260302.docx
- SOC2-summary-Redwood-2026.pdf (security FAQ + artifact summary)

If helpful I can prepare a single-sheet for procurement that lists invoice details, tax ID, and Redwood payment instructions — would you like that included in the MAP?

Thanks —
Camila

From: Dan Ortiz <dan.ortiz@acmecloud.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-04T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Procurement path, MAP & timeline for Acme Cloud

Thanks Camila — that all looks good. We’ll aim for PO (net-30). Elena and I will get procurement/finance onboarded this week and start the legal/security reviews.

Action items from Acme side:
- Procurement to confirm PO contact + any required invoice fields (ETA: 2026-03-05)
- Security to review SOC2 summary and request the full report under NDA if needed (ETA: 2026-03-09)
- Legal to review MSA and flag redlines (ETA: 2026-03-11)

Aditya — please can you prepare an order form / DocuSign-ready quote that includes both PO and AWS Marketplace purchase options? If you can target the quote by EOD 2026-03-04 that would be great.

I’ll update the MAP doc once procurement confirms invoice fields.

Thanks —
Dan Ortiz
Procurement Lead | Acme Cloud
dan.ortiz@acmecloud.com
